content: Several small Chrome extensions provide X and Twitter theming via pure CSS variable injection under Manifest V3 with no remote code: custom accent or multi-channel color editors and preset dark themes such as Midnight, AMOLED, Ocean, Forest, Sunset. No extension was found bundling curated community palettes explicitly named Dracula or Nord for X specifically; an accent color plus preset palette approach is a validated common pattern, and naming presets after Dracula or Nord would be a novel but plausible differentiator.
